positions.description:
Generative AI in Search
ML research to automate synthetic training data generation for Google's Search Generative Experience (SGE). My contributions are designing and building a scalable workflow for LLMs to generate high-quality data to train other LLMs, training PaLM2 on synthetic data generation, and generating thousands of synthetic training data points that are of the same quality as human-generated ones (through formal evaluation with human raters).
